title: YOUR FREE TRADE PAGE, NOW EASY TO FIND
summary: The free trade page is now featured across the site — in the top menu, the footer and on the homepage — so you can build and share yours in seconds.

sections.label: BETTER
items: Added to the main menu and mobile menu on every page.
Added a Free Trade Page link in the footer.
New homepage panel so first-time visitors can build a page straight away.

title: GET YOUR OWN FREE TRADE PAGE
summary: Build a clean, shareable page for your firm in under a minute — put it on quotes, WhatsApp, your van QR and socials. No login, no cost.

sections.label: NEW
items: Fill in your firm name, trade, area and contact — get an instant shareable page at jobfilter.uk/pro/your-firm.
One-tap COPY and SHARE ON WHATSAPP so you can send it straight to a customer.
Every page carries call and WhatsApp buttons so enquiries reach you fast.

title: FASTER, CLEARER FIRST SCANS
summary: Postcode, trade and radius now sit together at the top of Find Jobs. Choose all three and get straight to scanning your area.

sections.label: BETTER
items: The scanner is now the first thing you see.
A visible trade picker stops the wrong trade being scanned by mistake.
The postcode appears before the trade shortcuts, so the required first step is clear.

title: THE SCAN IS ALWAYS ONE TAP AWAY
summary: The top notice now takes you straight to Find Jobs, and patch examples are labelled clearly so you know where to check your own area.

sections.label: BETTER
items: Open the live scanner from the notice on any page.
Example patches no longer look like the full coverage list.

title: SEE WHAT MEMBERSHIP UNLOCKS
summary: Lead previews now make it clear which buyer details membership unlocks, with a direct route to pricing when the job fits.
availability: Live on lead previews and trade pages

sections.label: BETTER
items: Buyer-detail previews are now clear across trade pages.
A direct unlock route replaces blurred placeholder copy.
The membership choice appears after you have seen useful lead context.

title: THE GUARANTEE IS HARD TO MISS
summary: The 30-day money-back guarantee now appears beside the places where you decide to join, instead of being buried elsewhere.

sections.label: BETTER
items: The guarantee is shown across trade pages.
It now sits beside signal and weekly-alert offers.
It is also visible across free tools, comparisons and help pages.

title: LEAD ALERTS, IN PLAIN ENGLISH
summary: Alert setup now asks for your area and gives the real next step when a chosen alert speed is not included in your plan.

sections.label: FIXED
items: Removed postcode jargon from alert setup.
Replaced a misleading login error with the actual next step.
